effect_description_eng:
[When Digivolving] If a card with [Mamemon] in its name is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, 1 of your Digimon with [Mamemon] in its name may gain ＜Rush＞ (This Digimon can attack the turn it was played.) for the turn and attack. At the end of that attack, delete it.
[On Deletion] Delete 1 of your opponent's lowest DP Digimon. If this effect didn't delete, trash their top security card.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any of your other Digimon with [Mamemon] in their names are deleted, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with the lowest play cost.
xros_req: [Digivolve] Lv.5 w/[Mamemon] in name w/o [X Antibody] trait: Cost 1
